title: Gender Norms and the Quantity–Quality Tradeoff: Evidence from Free Primary Education in Africa
title_zh: 性别规范与数量-质量权衡：来自非洲免费初等教育的证据
title_primary: 性别规范与数量-质量权衡：来自非洲免费初等教育的证据
title_secondary: Gender Norms and the Quantity–Quality Tradeoff: Evidence from Free Primary Education in Africa
authors: Matthew Collins, Eleonora Guarnieri, Helmut Rainer, Fernanda Ortega, Dennis Snower 等
official: 官方在线 2026-02-09 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of free primary education (FPE) on parents’ fertility decisions in sub-Saharan Africa and how these effects depend on prevailing gender norms. Leveraging the staggered rollout of FPE across 17 countries and a within-ethnicity design, we find that the reform reduced completed fertility by 0.25 births per woman. Reduced fertility coincides with both improved child survival and school enrollment. Linking these data with ethnic-level cultural norms of male dominance, we show that these effects arise exclusively among groups with low male dominance. Consistent with fertility reductions increasing women’s autonomy, FPE also strengthens women’s outside options and intra-household bargaining power. In low male-dominance settings, this is reflected in higher divorce probabilities, lower acceptance of intimate partner violence, greater participation in household decisions, and increased media engagement — changes absent in high male-dominance cultures. A simple model embedding the quantity – quality tradeoff within a limited-commitment household bargaining framework, where gender norms determine women’s veto power over fertility, rationalizes these findings. Overall, the results underscore the central role of gender norms in shaping the effects of policy interventions on fertility and broader development outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了撒哈拉以南非洲地区免费初等教育（FPE）对父母生育决策的影响，以及这些影响如何取决于盛行的性别规范。利用17个国家FPE实施的分阶段推进及族群内部设计，我们发现该改革使每位女性的完成生育数减少了0.25个孩子。生育率的下降与儿童存活率和入学率的提高同时发生。将这些数据与族群层面的男性主导文化规范相结合，我们表明这些效应仅出现在男性主导程度较低的群体中。与生育率下降增强女性自主权相一致，FPE还强化了女性的外部选择权和家庭内部议价能力。在男性主导程度较低的环境中，这体现为离婚概率上升、对亲密伴侣暴力的接受度降低、家庭决策参与度提高以及媒体接触增加——而在男性主导程度较高的文化中这些变化则不存在。一个将数量—质量权衡嵌入有限承诺家庭议价框架的简单模型，其中性别规范决定女性对生育的否决权，能够合理解释这些发现。总体而言，研究结果强调了性别规范在塑造政策干预对生育及更广泛发展成果影响中的核心作用。

title: To Tax or To Ax? Marginal Tax and Spending Multipliers in Consolidations
title_zh: 征税还是削减？财政整顿中的边际税收与支出乘数
title_primary: 征税还是削减？财政整顿中的边际税收与支出乘数
title_secondary: To Tax or To Ax? Marginal Tax and Spending Multipliers in Consolidations
authors: Roberto Perotti, Luca Sala
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We introduce the notion of marginal cumulative multiplier — the effect of either government spending or taxation on output holding the other fiscal instrument constant — and apply it to a well known panel of consolidation episodes in 16 countries in the period 1978-2020. In our benchmark specification we estimate a marginal spending multiplier at two years of 1.5 and a marginal tax multiplier close to 0. We also estimate similar multipliers by applying the policy counterfactual method of McKay and Wolf (2023). In an extensive robustness analysis we never find spending multipliers below 1.3 or tax multipliers higher than -1. These findings are seemingly in contrast to those of much of the existing literature on fiscal multipliers, which typically finds higher tax than spending multipliers. We show that this contradiction disappears once the fiscal variables used in the literature are scaled by the proper factor.
abstract_zh: 我们引入了边际累积乘数的概念——即在保持另一财政工具不变的情况下，政府支出或税收对产出的影响——并将其应用于一个涵盖1978年至2020年间16个国家财政整顿事件的知名面板数据集。在我们的基准设定中，估计两年期的边际支出乘数为1.5，而边际税收乘数接近于0。我们还通过应用McKay和Wolf（2023）的政策反事实方法估计了类似的乘数。在广泛的稳健性分析中，我们从未发现支出乘数低于1.3或税收乘数高于-1的情况。这些发现似乎与现有财政乘数文献中的多数结论相悖，后者通常发现税收乘数高于支出乘数。我们表明，一旦文献中使用的财政变量按适当因子进行缩放，这一矛盾便消失。

title: Interlocking Directorates and Competition in Banking
title_zh: 银行间连锁董事与竞争
title_primary: 银行间连锁董事与竞争
title_secondary: Interlocking Directorates and Competition in Banking
authors: Guglielmo Barone, Fabiano Schivardi, Enrico Sette
official: 官方在线 2022-03-09 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the effects on corporate loan rates of an unexpected change in the Italian legislation which forbade interlocking directorates between banks. Exploiting multiple firm-bank relationships to fully account for all unobserved heterogeneity, we find that prohibiting interlocks decreased the interest rates of previously interlocked banks by 16 basis points relative to other banks. The effect is stronger for high quality firms and for loans extended by interlocked banks with a large joint market share. Interest rates on loans from previously interlocked banks become more dispersed. Finally, firms borrowing more from previously interlocked banks expand investment, employment and sales.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了意大利立法意外变更对公司贷款利率的影响，该立法禁止银行间互兼董事。利用多重企业-银行关系全面考虑所有未观测到的异质性，我们发现，禁止互兼董事使得先前存在互兼关系的银行贷款利率相对于其他银行降低了16个基点。这一效应在高质量企业和由具有较大联合市场份额的互兼银行发放的贷款中更为显著。来自先前互兼银行的贷款利率变得更加分散。最后，从先前互兼银行借款更多的企业扩大了投资、就业和销售。

title: Exorbitant Privilege of the Periodic Table? Geoeconomics, Endogenous Centrality and Strategic Minerals for the Green Transition,
title_zh: 周期表的特权？地缘经济学、内生中心性与绿色转型中的战略矿产
title_primary: 周期表的特权？地缘经济学、内生中心性与绿色转型中的战略矿产
title_secondary: Exorbitant Privilege of the Periodic Table? Geoeconomics, Endogenous Centrality and Strategic Minerals for the Green Transition,
authors: Josh Kirk, Evgenia Passari, Hélène Rey
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Trade networks underpinning the energy transition are endogenous economic objects, and their structure is a source of market power. Using bilateral trade data for thirteen electrification metals over 1995–2023, we show that trade in these materials has reorganised into a hub-and-spoke system centred on China, in sharp contrast to the more diffuse, multilateral structure of fossil fuels. This centrality did not follow from resource endowments: China holds few of the underlying reserves. It was built through processing investment, industrial policy, and commodity-targeted development finance, an equilibrium outcome rather than a geographical accident. We formalise this logic in a stylised model in which a country chooses how central to become, and show that centrality can map into pricing power: the response of the world price of critical minerals to a supply cut is stronger when the network is more concentrated, the downstream demand and the competitive fringe supply are more inelastic. Constructing text-based, commodity-specific supply shocks and estimating local projections, we find that supply contractions in critical metals raise consumer inflation in the European Union and the United States by roughly twice as much as comparable fossil-fuel shocks, and more persistently. Centrality is therefore not merely a descriptive feature of the new resource map: it can create leverage over global prices. The green transition reduces strategic dependence on hydrocarbon exporters but reconstitutes it around the architecture of mineral supply chains.
abstract_zh: 支撑能源转型的贸易网络是内生的经济对象，其结构构成市场势力的来源。利用1995年至2023年间十三种电气化金属的双边贸易数据，我们表明这些材料的贸易已重组为以中国为中心的轴辐体系，与化石燃料更为分散、多边的结构形成鲜明对比。这种中心地位并非源于资源禀赋：中国仅持有其中少部分的基础储量。它是通过加工投资、产业政策和针对特定大宗商品的发展融资构建而成，是均衡结果而非地理偶然。我们在一个简约模型中形式化了这一逻辑，在该模型中，一国选择其中心化程度，并表明中心地位可转化为定价权：当网络更为集中、下游需求及竞争性边缘供给更具刚性时，关键矿产的世界价格对供给削减的反应更为强烈。通过构建基于文本的、针对特定商品的供给冲击并估计局部投影，我们发现关键金属的供给收缩使欧盟和美国的消费者通胀上升幅度约为可比化石燃料冲击的两倍，且持续性更强。因此，中心地位不仅是新资源版图的描述性特征：它能够对全球价格产生杠杆作用。绿色转型减少了对碳氢化合物出口国的战略依赖，但围绕矿产供应链的架构重新构建了这种依赖。

title: World Agricultural Prices and the Onset of Civil War
title_zh: 世界农产品价格与内战爆发
title_primary: 世界农产品价格与内战爆发
title_secondary: World Agricultural Prices and the Onset of Civil War
authors: Antonio Ciccone
official: 官方在线 2026-08-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: I show that falling world agricultural prices increased the likelihood of civil war onset during 1957–2007, especially in Sub-Saharan Africa. A one-standard-deviation price decline raised the likelihood of onset by around 30 percent in the global sample of 118 countries and by around 45 percent in Sub-Saharan Africa, relative to average onset rates of around 2 percent per year. I reconcile these findings with earlier mixed results by showing that the estimated effect depends on how country-specific price indices are constructed. Price indices that isolate changes in world commodity prices yield statistically significant effects, whereas indices conflating price changes with changes in countries’ exports do not. The effect of world prices on civil war onset operated through agricultural producers rather than food consumers. Estimates are essentially unchanged when I control for consumer food-price shocks, and effects are substantially larger among countries whose agricultural exports consist mainly of cash crops. This points to an opportunity-cost channel whereby falling prices depress producer incomes and lower the opportunity cost of joining armed conflict. Export data for low- and middle-income countries are often measured with error. I develop an analysis of measurement error in year-by-year export shares and show that period-average export shares permit consistent estimation.
abstract_zh: 我证明，1957年至2007年间，世界农产品价格下跌增加了内战爆发的可能性，尤其是在撒哈拉以南非洲地区。在包含118个国家的全球样本中，价格一个标准差的下滑使爆发可能性相对于每年约2%的平均爆发率上升了约30%；而在撒哈拉以南非洲，这一增幅约为45%。我将这些发现与此前混杂的结果相调和，表明估计效应取决于国家特定价格指数的构建方式。仅隔离世界商品价格变动的指数产生了统计上显著的影响，而将价格变动与国家出口变动混为一谈的指数则不然。世界价格对内战爆发的影响是通过农业生产者而非食品消费者传导的。当我控制消费者食品价格冲击时，估计结果基本不变，且在以经济作物为主要农业出口的国家中，效应显著更大。这指向一种机会成本渠道，即价格下跌压低生产者收入，降低了加入武装冲突的机会成本。低收入和中等收入国家的出口数据常存在测量误差。我开发了一种针对逐年出口份额测量误差的分析方法，并表明期间平均出口份额能够实现一致估计。

title: Platform private-label production modes and manufacturer sales strategy choices under green product competition
title_zh: 绿色产品竞争下平台自有品牌生产模式与制造商销售策略选择
title_primary: 绿色产品竞争下平台自有品牌生产模式与制造商销售策略选择
title_secondary: Platform private-label production modes and manufacturer sales strategy choices under green product competition
authors: Yang Shen, Yuanzheng Wang, Longlong Xia, Qi Dong, Bowen Qin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: E-commerce platforms increasingly introduce private-label products that compete with green manufacturers’ products, while choosing among platform in-house production, outsourcing to green manufacturers, and outsourcing to OEM manufacturers. This study develops a game-theoretic model to examine how selling modes and production strategies affect green technology investment, platform–manufacturer cooperation, and private-label production choices, considering private-label market size, competition intensity, and consumer green preferences. Results show that when private-label market size exceeds a critical threshold, platform in-house production becomes optimal under both reselling and agency selling, with a lower threshold under reselling. As competition intensifies, green manufacturers reduce green technology investment. The platform adjusts its production strategy according to the cost difference between in-house production and outsourcing. From a supply chain perspective, agency selling achieves Pareto improvement over reselling within intermediate commission-rate ranges when no private label is introduced, production is in-house, or production is outsourced to green manufacturers. However, under outsourcing to OEM manufacturers, reselling achieves a win–win outcome over agency selling within an intermediate commission-rate range. KEYWORDS: Platform sales mode private-label production mode green manufacturer JEL CLASSIFICATION: L81 L13 Q56
abstract_zh: 电商平台日益引入自有品牌产品，与绿色制造商的产品形成竞争，同时需在平台自产、外包给绿色制造商及外包给OEM制造商之间做出选择。本研究构建博弈论模型，考察销售模式与生产策略如何影响绿色技术投资、平台与制造商合作及自有品牌生产选择，并考虑自有品牌市场规模、竞争强度及消费者绿色偏好等因素。研究结果表明，当自有品牌市场规模超过临界阈值时，平台自产在转售模式和代理销售模式下均为最优选择，且转售模式下的阈值更低。随着竞争加剧，绿色制造商减少绿色技术投资。平台根据自产与外包之间的成本差异调整其生产策略。从供应链视角看，在不引入自有品牌、采用自产或外包给绿色制造商的情况下，代理销售在中等佣金率区间内相对于转售模式实现帕累托改进。然而，在外包给OEM制造商的情形下，转售模式在中等佣金率区间内相对于代理销售实现双赢结果。关键词：平台销售模式；自有品牌生产模式；绿色制造商 JEL分类：L81 L13 Q56

title: DP19894 Currency Development Through Liquidity Provision
title_zh: 通过流动性供给推动货币发展
title_primary: 通过流动性供给推动货币发展
title_secondary: DP19894 Currency Development Through Liquidity Provision
authors: Antonio Coppola, Arvind Krishnamurthy, Chenzi Xu
official: 官方在线 2025-01-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Drawing on the experiences of the historical Eurodollar market and recent Chinese dollar bond issuances traded outside U.S. jurisdiction at negative spreads to Treasurys, we examine the conditions under which a parallel offshore dollar financial system that circumvents Western sanctions may emerge. We propose a model in which currency use is driven by liquidity provision and safe bond supply. We characterize three equilibrium regimes: high convenience yields emerge in both the initial sanctions-driven region and the final liquidity-driven region, separated by an intermediate region. Transitions between equilibria depend on safe-asset supply and liquidity technologies, in addition to endogenous dynamic complementarities.
abstract_zh: 借鉴历史上欧洲美元市场的经验，以及近期在美国管辖范围之外交易、相对于美国国债呈现负利差的中国美元债券发行情况，我们探讨了在何种条件下，一个规避西方制裁的平行离岸美元金融体系可能应运而生。我们提出一个模型，其中货币使用受流动性供给和安全债券供应驱动。我们刻画了三种均衡状态：在最初由制裁驱动的区域和最终由流动性驱动的区域，均出现高便利收益率，而两者之间隔着一个中间区域。均衡之间的转换不仅取决于安全资产供给和流动性技术，还受到内生动态互补性的影响。

title: Oligopoly, Macroeconomic Performance, and Competition Policy
title_zh: 寡头垄断、宏观经济表现与竞争政策
title_primary: 寡头垄断、宏观经济表现与竞争政策
title_secondary: Oligopoly, Macroeconomic Performance, and Competition Policy
authors: José Azar, Xavier Vives
official: 官方在线 2018-06-19 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a macroeconomic framework in which firms are large and have market power with respect to both products and labor. Each firm maximizes a share-weighted average of shareholder utilities, which makes the equilibrium independent of price normalization. In a one-sector economy, if returns to scale are non-increasing, then an increase in “effective” market concentration (which accounts for overlapping ownership) leads to declines in employment, real wages, and the labor share. Moreover, if the goal is to foster employment then (i) controlling common ownership and reducing concentration are complements and (ii) government jobs are a substitute for either policy. Yet when there are multiple sectors, due to an intersectoral pecuniary externality, an increase in common ownership can stimulate the economy when the elasticity of labor supply is high relative to the elasticity of substitution in product markets. We characterize for which ownership structures the monopolistically competitive limit or an oligopolistic one (where firms become small relative to the economy) are attained as the number of sectors in the economy increases. Finally, we provide a calibration to illustrate our results.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个宏观经济框架，其中企业规模庞大，并在产品与劳动力市场上均拥有市场势力。每家企业最大化股东效用的份额加权平均值，这使得均衡独立于价格归一化。在单一部门经济中，若规模报酬非递增，则“有效”市场集中度（考虑重叠所有权）的提升会导致就业、实际工资及劳动份额的下降。此外，若目标是促进就业，则（一）控制共同所有权与降低集中度是互补的，（二）政府就业岗位是任一政策的替代品。然而，在多部门情况下，由于部门间的货币外部性，当劳动供给弹性相对于产品市场替代弹性较高时，共同所有权的增加可能刺激经济。我们刻画了随着经济中部门数量增加，何种所有权结构下可实现垄断竞争极限或寡头垄断极限（其中企业相对于经济规模变得微小）。最后，我们提供校准分析以说明我们的结果。

title: Effect of social information on competition choice
title_zh: 社会信息对竞争选择的影响
title_primary: 社会信息对竞争选择的影响
title_secondary: Effect of social information on competition choice
authors: Ritwik Banerjee, Lata Gangadharan, Anand Kumar, Srinivasan Murali
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We show that social information about competition choices influences individuals’ willingness to compete. In a laboratory experiment, participants perform a real-effort task under piece-rate and tournament incentives, and subsequently participate in two choice rounds. We vary the information provided between the two choice rounds across three treatments. We find that social information on the proportion of participants that choose to compete in the first round affects the willingness to compete in the second round. Salience of payment schemes does not explain this result. Observing a lower willingness to compete by others increases the likelihood of one’s own willingness to compete. This suggests that participants strategically choose to compete based on their treatment induced belief about the average ability of other participants, and this is consistent with predictions from a rational model of Bayesian learning. This effect is particularly strong for women.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，关于竞争选择的社会信息会影响个体的竞争意愿。在一项实验室实验中，参与者在计件薪酬和锦标赛激励下完成一项实际努力任务，随后参与两轮选择。我们在三个处理组中改变两轮选择之间提供的信息。我们发现，第一轮中选择竞争的参与者比例这一社会信息，会影响第二轮中的竞争意愿。支付方案的显著性并不能解释这一结果。观察到他人较低的竞争意愿会增加自身竞争意愿的可能性。这表明，参与者基于处理诱导的关于其他参与者平均能力的信念，策略性地选择是否竞争，这与贝叶斯学习的理性模型预测相一致。这一效应在女性中尤为显著。

title: Cognitive Aging and Long-Term Care in Italy
title_zh: 意大利的认知老化与长期护理
title_primary: 意大利的认知老化与长期护理
title_secondary: Cognitive Aging and Long-Term Care in Italy
authors: Agar Brugiavini, Ludovico Carrino, Gloria Moroni, Rinaldo Naci, Giacomo Pasini
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This chapter examines the incidence and economic burden of cognitive impairment among older individuals in Italy within the long-term care (LTC) system. Using SHARE Wave 9 data (2022), cognitive impairment is measured through standardized memory and numeracy tests, classifying 8.6% of individuals aged 65+ as cognitively impaired. Cognitive decline rises sharply with age and is strongly associated with higher care needs, particularly intensive formal care. While both physically and cognitively impaired individuals rely heavily on informal care, cognitively impaired individuals receive substantially more hours of care. Total LTC costs amount to $35.3 billion (1.66% of GDP), with cognitively impaired individuals accounting for the largest share of expenditures. Informal care represents a greater financial burden than formal care across all groups. The findings highlight significant unmet care needs and underscore the urgent necessity of policy reforms and healthy ageing strategies to ensure LTC sustainability.
abstract_zh: 本章考察了意大利长期照护体系中老年人群认知障碍的发生率及其经济负担。基于SHARE第9轮（2022年）数据，通过标准化记忆与计算能力测试对认知障碍进行测量，结果显示65岁及以上老年人口中8.6%存在认知障碍。认知功能衰退随年龄增长显著加剧，并与更高的照护需求（尤其是密集型正式照护）密切相关。尽管身体功能障碍与认知障碍群体均高度依赖非正式照护，但认知障碍者获得的照护时长显著更多。长期照护总成本达353亿美元（占GDP的1.66%），其中认知障碍群体占据最大支出份额。在所有群体中，非正式照护的经济负担均高于正式照护。研究结果揭示了大量未满足的照护需求，并强调亟需通过政策改革与健康老龄化战略保障长期照护体系的可持续性。

abstract: this Paper, we review recent empirical evidence regarding the special role of banks for the corporate governance of German firms. We differentiate between large exchange-listed firms and small and medium sized companies throughout. With respect to the role of banks as monitoring investors, the evidence does not unanimously support a special role of banks for large firms. Only one study finds that banks? control of management goes beyond what non-bank shareholders achieve. Proxy-voting rights apparently do not provide a significant means for banks to exert management control. Most of the recent evidence regarding small firms suggests that a Hausbank relationship can indeed be beneficial. Hausbanks are more willing to sustain financing when borrower quality deteriorates, and they invest more often than arm?s-length banks in workouts if borrowers face financial distress.
abstract_zh: 本文回顾了关于银行在德国公司治理中特殊作用的最新实证证据。我们始终区分大型上市企业与中小型企业。就银行作为监督投资者的角色而言，证据并未一致支持银行对大型企业具有特殊作用。仅有一项研究发现，银行对管理层的控制超越了非银行股东所能实现的程度。代理投票权显然并未为银行提供显著的管理控制手段。关于小型企业的大多数最新证据表明，主银行关系确实可能带来益处。当借款人质量恶化时，主银行更愿意维持融资；若借款人面临财务困境，主银行比保持距离型银行更频繁地参与债务重组。

title: Combinatorial Discrete Choice: Theory and Application to Multinational Production
title_zh: 组合离散选择：理论与跨国生产中的应用
title_primary: 组合离散选择：理论与跨国生产中的应用
title_secondary: Combinatorial Discrete Choice: Theory and Application to Multinational Production
authors: Arkolakis, Costas, Eckert, Fabian, Shi, Rowan
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: In general, finding the optimal combination among N items requires evaluating all 2^N possibilities. We develop a method applicable whenever items are complements or substitutes that uses this structure to discard suboptimal combinations without evaluation and extends to heterogeneous-agent environments. In a calibrated general equilibrium model of multinational firms choosing interdependent production locations, we show the method is orders of magnitude faster than incumbent approaches and avoids error from discretizing firm heterogeneity. Quantitatively, whether production locations are complements or substitutes determines whether welfare gains from multinational production concentrate in the most productive countries or accrue more broadly.
abstract_zh: 一般而言，从N个选项中寻找最优组合需要评估全部2^N种可能性。我们提出了一种适用于互补品或替代品情形的方法，该方法利用这种结构在不进行评估的情况下剔除次优组合，并可推广至异质性主体环境。在跨国企业选择相互依赖的生产地点的校准一般均衡模型中，我们证明该方法比现有方法快数个数量级，且避免了因离散化企业异质性而产生的误差。从定量角度看，生产地点是互补品还是替代品，决定了跨国生产带来的福利收益是集中于最具生产力的国家，还是更广泛地惠及各国。

title: The role of location-oriented policy in promoting the development of new quality productivity in regions
title_zh: 区位导向政策在促进区域新质生产力发展中的作用
title_primary: 区位导向政策在促进区域新质生产力发展中的作用
title_secondary: The role of location-oriented policy in promoting the development of new quality productivity in regions
authors: Dong Li, Shaoyu Liu, Pei Du, Juntao Du
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Accelerating the advancement of new quality productivity (Newprod) has emerged as an essential strategic imperative for nations to navigate global competition and strengthen their capacity for sustainable development. Building on this premise, this study employs data from 280 cities spanning the period from 2009 to 2022 and takes national-level new areas as a representative example to rigorously examine whether location-oriented policy contributes to the advancement of Newprod. The robustness of the findings is verified through multidimensional sensitivity analyses. Empirical results demonstrate that the creation of new areas substantially enhances Newprod, operating through the positive moderating effects of government led technology investment and regional marketization levels. Furthermore, mechanism testing confirms that the policy accelerates Newprod by driving tertiary industry agglomeration while concurrently suppressing traditional manufacturing agglomeration. Further analysis reveals significant structural variations in policy effectiveness. From a spatial configuration standpoint, the single city development model demonstrates superior performance compared to the dual city collaborative model. From an administrative hierarchy perspective, policy impacts are more significant in cities with elevated administrative status.
abstract_zh: 加速发展新质生产力已成为各国应对全球竞争、增强可持续发展能力的重要战略选择。基于此，本研究利用2009—2022年280个城市的面板数据，以国家级新区为典型代表，严谨考察了区位导向型政策是否有助于推动新质生产力发展，并通过多维敏感性分析验证了研究结果的稳健性。实证结果表明，新区的设立显著提升了新质生产力水平，其作用机制在于政府主导的科技投入与区域市场化水平发挥了正向调节效应。进一步机制检验证实，该政策通过驱动第三产业集聚、同时抑制传统制造业集聚的路径加速了新质生产力发展。深入分析发现，政策效应存在显著的结构性差异：从空间布局看，单城发展模式的效果优于双城协同模式；从行政层级看，政策在行政级别较高的城市中影响更为显著。

title: The Rise of Female Autonomy and the Decline of Fertility: The Role of Mismatch
title_zh: 女性自主权的上升与生育率的下降：错配的作用

title_secondary: The Rise of Female Autonomy and the Decline of Fertility: The Role of Mismatch
authors: Claudia Goldin
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The fertility decline is everywhere in the world today and goes back decades for rich countries. Birthrates have been below replacement in the U.S. and Europe since the mid-1970s. Completed cohort fertility in the U.S. was lower for those born in 1955 than for 1975. The reasons for the initial declines involve greater female autonomy and a mismatch between the desires of men and women. Men generally benefit more from maintaining traditions; women often benefit more from eschewing them. When the probability is low that men will abandon traditions, some career women will not have children and others will delay.
abstract_zh: 当今世界普遍存在生育率下降现象，富裕国家的这一趋势已持续数十年。自20世纪70年代中期以来，美国和欧洲的生育率一直低于更替水平。美国1955年出生队列的终身生育率低于1975年出生队列。生育率最初下降的原因涉及女性自主权增强以及男女意愿的错配。男性通常更倾向于维持传统，而女性往往更受益于摒弃传统。当男性放弃传统的可能性较低时，部分职业女性会选择不生育，另一些则会推迟生育。

title: Threshold spatial panel regression with fixed effects
title_zh: 固定效应阈值空间面板回归
title_primary: 固定效应阈值空间面板回归
title_secondary: Threshold spatial panel regression with fixed effects
authors: Xiaoyu Meng, Zhenlin Yang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We introduce general estimation and inference methods for threshold spatial panel regression with two-way fixed effects in a diminishing-threshold-effects framework. A valid objective function is obtained through a simple adjustment on the concentrated quasi loglikelihood with fixed effects being concentrated out, which leads to a consistent estimation of all common parameters. We show that the estimation of threshold parameter has a negligible effect on the asymptotic distribution of the main parameter estimators and thereby regular inference methods apply, though a bias correction may be necessary. The limiting distribution of the threshold parameter estimator is shown to be non-regular and infeasible, and for inference, a likelihood ratio test procedure is proposed. The test for the non-existence of threshold effects faces an identification issue at the null. To overcome this difficulty, we propose a sup-Wald test and a bootstrap method for its critical values. Monte Carlo results show that the proposed methods perform well in finite samples. An empirical application is presented on age-of-leader effects on political competitions across Chinese cities.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在阈值效应递减框架下，针对具有双向固定效应的阈值空间面板回归的通用估计与推断方法。通过简单调整集中拟对数似然函数，并消去固定效应，我们获得了一个有效的目标函数，从而实现对所有共同参数的一致估计。研究表明，阈值参数的估计对主要参数估计量的渐近分布影响可忽略不计，因此常规推断方法适用，尽管可能需要进行偏差校正。阈值参数估计量的极限分布被证明是非正则且不可行的，为此，我们提出了一种似然比检验程序进行推断。对于阈值效应不存在性的检验，在零假设下存在识别问题。为克服这一困难，我们提出了一个sup-Wald检验及其临界值的自助法。蒙特卡洛结果表明，所提方法在有限样本中表现良好。我们还提供了一个实证应用，研究中国各城市政治竞争中领导人年龄效应的影响。

title: Intensification without empowerment? Gendered time burdens in India's livestock sector
title_zh: 强化而无赋权？印度畜牧业中的性别化时间负担
title_primary: 强化而无赋权？印度畜牧业中的性别化时间负担
title_secondary: Intensification without empowerment? Gendered time burdens in India's livestock sector
authors: Kumar, Anjani, Singh, Dhiraj K., Kumar, Nalini Ranjan
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper provides a nationally representative assessment of changes in women’s work in livestock rearing in rural India using unit-level data from the Time Use Surveys (TUS) 2019 and 2024. By situating the analysis within debates on the feminization of agriculture, the study examines shifts in participation and time allocation in livestock rearing among rural working-age individuals (15–59 years). While women’s participation in economic work increased modestly between 2019 and 2024, this expansion continues to coexist with a persistently high burden of unpaid domestic and caregiving services. Within agriculture, livestock emerges as a relatively more dynamic and gendered domain of work. Using the 2016 International Classification of Activities for Time-Use Statistics (ICATUS), livestock activities are disaggregated into own use and market-oriented livestock activities. Descriptive evidence shows that women’s participation in livestock activities increased from 11 percent in 2019 to 15 percent in 2024, with a particularly notable rise in market-oriented livestock activities across several states and agroecological zones. Although crop husbandry continues to dominate agricultural employment, both incidence and intensity of participation of women in livestock rearing has visibly increased. Regression results indicate a positive and significant year effect for total livestock and livestock activities, but not for livestock own-use activities, suggesting that the observed increase is primarily associated with market-oriented engagement rather than subsistence expansion. Education exhibits a strong negative association with livestock time use, especially for women, indicating that livestock remains a fallback activity under constrained employment options. Gelbach decomposition further shows that changes in age composition and educational attainment account for a substantial share of the explained variation, while monthly per capita consumption expenditure has a stronger and more consistently significant association with women’s livestock time use than men’s. Overall, the findings point to incremental change within a persistently gendered structure of rural time allocation.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2019年和2024年时间使用调查（TUS）的单元级数据，对印度农村女性在牲畜饲养领域工作的变化进行了全国代表性评估。通过将分析置于农业女性化议题的讨论中，本研究考察了农村劳动年龄人口（15-59岁）在牲畜饲养中的参与率及时间分配变化。尽管2019年至2024年间女性经济工作参与率略有上升，但这种增长仍与持续高负荷的无偿家务和照料服务并存。在农业领域，牲畜饲养成为相对更具动态性和性别差异的工作领域。基于2016年《时间使用统计国际分类》（ICATUS），本文将牲畜活动细分为自用型和市场导向型两类。描述性证据显示，女性参与牲畜活动的比例从2019年的11%增至2024年的15%，其中多个邦和农业生态区的市场导向型牲畜活动增长尤为显著。尽管作物种植仍主导农业就业，但女性参与牲畜饲养的广度和强度均明显提升。回归结果表明，总牲畜活动和市场导向型活动存在显著正向年份效应，但自用型活动不显著，说明观察到的增长主要与市场导向型参与相关，而非自给型扩张。教育水平与牲畜时间使用呈强负相关，尤其对女性而言，表明在就业选择受限时，牲畜饲养仍是替代性活动。Gelbach分解进一步显示，年龄结构和教育程度的变化解释了大部分可解释变异，而月人均消费支出对女性牲畜时间使用的影响比男性更强且更持续显著。总体而言，研究结果揭示了农村时间分配在持续性别化结构中的渐进式变化。

title: Direct democracy and political extremism
title_zh: 直接民主与政治极端主义
title_primary: 直接民主与政治极端主义
title_secondary: Direct democracy and political extremism
authors: Nicolas Schreiner, Alois Stutzer
official: 官方在线 2026-06-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study how citizens' right to directly decide on policies through popular initiatives affects the attractiveness of extreme candidates in representative elections. In our theoretical framework, single prominent policy issues on which individual voters hold extreme views get a large weight in their assessment of candidates, thereby favouring ideologically extreme ones. If citizens can decide the controversial policy issues separately on the ballot, then this decouples the issues from legislative politics, and moderate candidates become relatively more attractive to voters. We apply our theory to US state legislative elections, and find that ideologically extreme candidates receive significantly lower voter support in initiative than in non-initiative states. This holds in particular for states with low qualification requirements for initiatives. In concurrent elections for the US House of Representatives, we do not observe this difference in the electoral success of extreme candidates between initiative and non-initiative states. The effect seems to be partly mediated by lower campaign donations to extreme candidates.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了公民通过民众倡议直接决定政策的权利如何影响代议制选举中极端候选人的吸引力。在我们的理论框架中，选民对个别突出政策议题持有极端观点，这些议题在评估候选人时占据较大权重，从而有利于意识形态极端的候选人。如果公民能在选票上分别决定争议性政策议题，这将使这些议题与立法政治脱钩，温和候选人对选民而言相对更具吸引力。我们将理论应用于美国州立法选举，发现意识形态极端的候选人在倡议州获得的选民支持显著低于非倡议州。这一现象在倡议资格要求较低的州尤为明显。在同时举行的美国众议院选举中，我们未观察到倡议州与非倡议州之间极端候选人选举成功的这种差异。该效应似乎部分由极端候选人获得的竞选捐款减少所中介。

title: Tax Progressivity of Carbon and Gasoline Taxes: The Role of Income Inequality
title_zh: 碳税与汽油税的累进性：收入不平等的作用
title_primary: 碳税与汽油税的累进性：收入不平等的作用
title_secondary: Tax Progressivity of Carbon and Gasoline Taxes: The Role of Income Inequality
authors: Julius J. Andersson, Giles Atkinson
official: 官方在线 2026-06-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We present a simple model showing how income inequality and the income elasticity of demand jointly shape the tax progressivity of indirect taxes, with rising inequality increasing the regressivity of taxes on necessities. We test the model’s predictions by analyzing the Swedish carbon tax on transport fuel. We find that the tax becomes increasingly regressive over time, closely tracking rising income inequality. We also show that the relative incidence shifts from regressive to progressive when using annual expenditure rather than annual income as the welfare measure, as expenditure is more evenly distributed. A cross-country analysis of gasoline taxes in high-income nations further supports our findings, establishing a strong correlation between higher inequality and greater regressivity. Our model helps policymakers identify when complementary redistributive measures such as lump-sum transfers may become necessary.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个简约模型，揭示收入不平等与需求收入弹性如何共同塑造间接税的累进性：不平等加剧会提高必需品税的累退性。通过分析瑞典交通燃料碳税，我们验证了模型预测：该税种的累退性随时间推移持续增强，与收入不平等加剧趋势高度吻合。研究还表明，当采用年度支出（而非年度收入）作为福利衡量指标时，相对税负分布从累退转为累进——因为支出分布更为均衡。对高收入国家汽油税的跨国分析进一步支持了我们的发现：不平等程度越高，累退性越强。该模型有助于政策制定者识别何时需要配套实施一次性转移支付等再分配措施。

title: The Apple Does Not Fall Far From the Tree: Intergenerational Persistence of Dietary Habits
title_zh: 苹果不会落在离树太远的地方：饮食习惯的代际持续性
title_primary: 苹果不会落在离树太远的地方：饮食习惯的代际持续性
title_secondary: The Apple Does Not Fall Far From the Tree: Intergenerational Persistence of Dietary Habits
authors: Frédéric Kluser, Martina Pons
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper provides novel evidence on how dietary habits – a key health behavior – are transmitted across generations, exploiting unique grocery transaction data linked with administrative records. We document strong intergenerational persistence in dietary habits, exceeding that of income, and consider several channels that might explain this pattern. Specifically, we find that socioeconomic status and geography account for only a small share of the transmission. Combined with the absence of a dietary response following a parent’s unexpected lifestyle-related death, these findings underscore the importance of early-life influences and habit formation.
abstract_zh: 本文利用与行政记录相关联的独特杂货交易数据，提供了关于饮食习惯——这一关键健康行为——如何代际传递的新证据。我们记录了饮食习惯中显著的代际持续性，其程度超过收入，并考察了可能解释这一模式的若干渠道。具体而言，我们发现社会经济地位和地理因素仅能解释传递中的一小部分。结合父母因生活方式相关意外死亡后饮食行为未发生变化的发现，这些结果强调了早期生活影响和习惯形成的重要性。

title: Bayesian model averaging with non-conjugate priors
title_zh: 非共轭先验下的贝叶斯模型平均
title_primary: 非共轭先验下的贝叶斯模型平均
title_secondary: Bayesian model averaging with non-conjugate priors
authors: Anastasios E. Tasiopoulos, Efthymios G. Tsionas, Nikolaos D. Vlastakis
official: 官方在线 2026-05-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper considers the case of non-conjugate prior distributions for Bayesian model averaging (BMA). Although the natural conjugate setting is the default choice for BMA, mainly for reasons of analytical tractability, it has come under considerable criticism due to its unrealistic assumptions about prior information, among others. In this study, we extend the literature by considering two special cases of the multivariate Student-t distribution. We obtain closed-form solutions using Laplace approximations and apply our techniques to a controlled numerical experiment and cross-country growth regressions. Our results show that, under fine tuning of the hyperparameters, the proposed approach has similar performance to the conjugate alternatives on synthetic datasets, whereas in real data it favors, on average, more parsimonious models than the conjugate alternatives and also exhibits superior predictive performance.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了贝叶斯模型平均（BMA）中非共轭先验分布的情形。尽管自然共轭设置因解析便利性而成为BMA的默认选择，但其关于先验信息的不切实际假设已受到广泛批评。在本研究中，我们通过考虑多元学生t分布的两种特殊情况来扩展现有文献。我们利用拉普拉斯近似获得了闭式解，并将我们的技术应用于受控数值实验和跨国增长回归中。结果表明，在超参数精细调整下，所提方法在合成数据集上的表现与共轭替代方法相似，而在实际数据中，它平均倾向于比共轭替代方法更简约的模型，并展现出更优的预测性能。

title: Heterogeneity and the Macro‐Economic Effects of Changes in Loan‐to‐Value Limits
title_zh: 贷款价值比限制变化的异质性与宏观经济效应
title_primary: 贷款价值比限制变化的异质性与宏观经济效应
title_secondary: Heterogeneity and the Macro‐Economic Effects of Changes in Loan‐to‐Value Limits
authors: EMMANUEL DE VEIRMAN, JASPER DE JONG
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2025-11-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A prominent approach to estimating the macro‐economic effects of loan‐to‐value (LTV) limits involves the use of cross‐country panel regressions. This approach assumes that the effects of changes in LTV limits are constant across economies and across time. In this paper, we develop and implement an approach that uses the micro‐level LTV distribution to compute the effect of changes in the limit in an individual economy. Our approach reflects the intuition that when a limit binds for a larger fraction of households, changes in the limit have larger macro‐economic effects.
abstract_zh: 估计贷款价值比（LTV）限制宏观经济效应的一种主流方法涉及使用跨国面板回归。该方法假设LTV限制变化的影响在不同经济体及不同时期是恒定的。在本文中，我们开发并实施了一种方法，利用微观层面的LTV分布来计算单个经济体中限制变化的影响。我们的方法体现了这样的直觉：当限制对更大比例的家庭具有约束力时，限制变化会产生更大的宏观经济效应。

title: The impact of public data on supply chain concentration: evidence from public data open platforms in China
title_zh: 公共数据对供应链集中度的影响：来自中国公共数据开放平台的证据
title_primary: 公共数据对供应链集中度的影响：来自中国公共数据开放平台的证据
title_secondary: The impact of public data on supply chain concentration: evidence from public data open platforms in China
authors: Xinyu Hu, Jing Li
official: 官方在线 2025-09-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Public data, as a strategic resource for national development, plays a critical role in shaping enterprise supply chain structures. This study investigates whether and how public data openness affects supply chain concentration in Chinese enterprises. Using data from A-share listed firms from 2002 to 2022 and exploiting the staggered establishment of provincial public data platforms as a quasi-natural experiment, we identify a significant negative effect of public data openness on supply chain concentration. The mechanism tests suggest that this effect operates primarily through the enhancement of enterprise innovation and operational efficiency. Heterogeneity analysis further shows that the impact is more pronounced for labour-intensive, technology-intensive, and low-competitive advantage firms. These findings highlight the economic value of public data and suggest that promoting public data openness can facilitate supply chain diversification, enhance enterprise flexibility, and improve resilience in the face of external shocks.
abstract_zh: 公共数据作为国家发展的战略性资源，在塑造企业供应链结构中发挥着关键作用。本研究探讨公共数据开放是否以及如何影响中国企业的供应链集中度。利用2002至2022年A股上市公司数据，并以省级公共数据平台的渐进式设立作为准自然实验，我们发现公共数据开放对供应链集中度具有显著的负向效应。机制检验表明，该效应主要通过提升企业创新能力和运营效率实现。异质性分析进一步显示，对于劳动密集型、技术密集型以及低竞争优势企业，这一影响更为显著。这些发现凸显了公共数据的经济价值，表明推动公共数据开放有助于促进供应链多元化、增强企业灵活性，并提升应对外部冲击的韧性。
